name: Godot AI
what: An MCP server and Godot editor plugin that connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients to a live Godot editor. Its tools let the AI build scenes, edit nodes and scripts, wire signals and set up UI, materials, animation, particles and cameras. GDScript is fully supported; C# is text-only. MIT licensed.
who: Godot 4.7+ developers who want an AI assistant that can work inside the editor, not just edit files.

setup.text: Install uv, then download a release from github.com/hi-godot/godot-ai/releases and place the add-on at your-project/addons/godot_ai/ (plugin.cfg goes inside that folder).
In Godot, enable it: Project → Project Settings → Plugins → Godot AI.
In the Godot AI dock, press Configure next to your MCP client (or Configure all), then restart the client if needed.

prompts: Create a 2D player scene with a CharacterBody2D, sprite and collision shape, plus a movement script.
Build a pause menu UI and wire the Resume button's signal.
Add a particle effect for coin pickups.
